subject.title: Google Chat: Add threaded reply support + receive all messages in spaces

question: Should the bundled Google Chat plugin add a user-OAuth or Workspace Events path for receiving non-mention Space messages, or keep service-account mention-gated webhooks as the supported model?
rationale: The remaining request changes credential storage, user consent/scopes, event subscription behavior, and what Space messages OpenClaw can observe; source inspection can prove the gap, but automation cannot choose the permanent security and product boundary.

options.title: Approve plugin-local OAuth/events design
options.body: Add a SecretRef-backed user OAuth or Workspace Events design for all-message ingestion while preserving service-account webhook verification and explicit mention-gated defaults until users opt in.

options.title: Keep service-account-only Spaces
options.body: Document that Google Chat Spaces remain mention-gated under service-account webhooks and close or narrow all-message ingestion requests to supported fallbacks.

options.title: Consolidate under broader Workspace auth
options.body: Defer this issue until maintainers define a shared Google Workspace consent, subscription, and credential model across plugins.

recommendation.title: Approve plugin-local OAuth/events design
recommendation.body: Add a SecretRef-backed user OAuth or Workspace Events design for all-message ingestion while preserving service-account webhook verification and explicit mention-gated defaults until users opt in.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent combination of current Google Chat code history and maintainer-side review context for the related OAuth/threading decisions.
